en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a rectangular building with a long colonnaded façade, front steps, ornamental fence, and trees in the foreground. The upper margin reads "EXPOSITION COLONIALE INTERNATIONALE – PARIS 1931," indicating it depicts a pavilion from the 1931 Paris Colonial Exposition. The caption below the image identifies the building as the Musée des Colonies and credits architect Laprade & Joussey.
